ns2:course.label: Making and Meaning
ns2:course.description: Introduction to the relationship of material, method, and process to meaning in art practice. Through research, critique, and application of concepts in material studio processes, students will explore a diverse range of methods of achieving meaning in an artwork. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours in separate terms.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours in separate terms.
